context_requirements: AR-positive lineage (prostate or breast cancer cells)
Intact AR coactivator recruitment for full agonist response
falsifiers: No change in AR-dependent genes (e.g., FKBP4, NCOA3, KDM3A) at 6 h in VCAP or MCF7
No antiproliferative or apoptotic signature at 24 h in AR-positive lines
Equivalent transcriptional response in AR-negative lines (PC3, A375, HA1E) as in AR-positive lines
Strong proliferation_down signature in PC3, which lacks functional AR

evidence.supports: Genistein acts as a tissue-specific AR modulator, attenuating or activating AR-dependent transcription in vivo
Ginsenoside Rb1 is a selective AR modulator that transactivates AR target genes via an androgen-responsive element
SARM MK-4541 has anti-androgenic activity in prostate cancer and inhibits proliferation/induces apoptosis in AR-positive cells
Ostarine is a SARM with tissue-selective AR-mediated effects on bone
SARM S-101479 modulates AR transcriptional activity with altered cofactor recruitment compared with DHT
